Here is a comprehensive, entry-by-entry transcription of the historical marriage register visible in `image_e16aa4.png`.

The register is written in Latin and divided into two pages. The left column covers the end of **1857** and transitions into **1858**, while the right column contains entries for January and February **1858**.
